cases.name: Kwashunda Watson
cases.about: Family and friends are remembering her as a joyful, kindhearted woman. Her father, Charles Johnson, said his daughter was known for her personality and willingness to help others. “She was a joyful type of individual, everybody liked her,” Johnson said. “Her popularity didn’t come from materialistic things, she was genuine, people liked her because of her personality.” Friend Burkwin Parker described Kwashunda Watson as someone who had been well-liked since her school days. “She was a kind individual with a heart of gold,” Parker said. “She was a member of the band in high school, she was on the homecoming court, she was very popular during her school days and she was a fun person to be around.”
